title: Anthropic IPO Report Reveals Dario Amodei’s $18M Pay Package
source_used: Reuters report (6 Oct 2026) as relayed by Channel Insider; cross-checked with Daily Sabah (Reuters copy)
key_facts: Dario Amodei's reported total compensation for 2025 was $18 million, per Anthropic's IPO prospectus obtained by Reuters (Channel Insider calls it confidential).
Most of it was stock and options.
Amodei and his sister Daniela Amodei, Anthropic president, each had annual base salaries doubled to $1.4 million in July 2026; her 2025 total was $16.4 million.
In 2026 the board granted both restricted stock units, some tied to continued employment and some to the IPO.
CFO Krishna Rao earned $720,250 in 2025 and exercised options worth $385,285.
Equilar's Courtney Yu said the $18 million "seems on the lower end for a company valued at $2 trillion".
Channel Insider notes the conditions concern retention and the listing and do not establish changes to strategy, pricing or safety commitments.
quote_evidence: CEO Dario Amodei’s reported total compensation for 2025 was $18 million, according to Anthropic’s confidential IPO prospectus obtained by Reuters.
Amodei and his sister, Anthropic President Daniela Amodei, each had their annual base salaries doubled to $1.4 million in July 2026, Reuters reported.
Chief Financial Officer Krishna Rao earned $720,250 in 2025 and separately exercised options worth $385,285.
why_it_matters_hint: A first look at executive pay in Anthropic's IPO documents, with the full ownership picture still to come.
event_date: 6 Oct 2026 (Reuters exclusive); Channel Insider relay 9 Oct 2026
